_comment: Spells in their 2024 Player's Handbook versions (numbers checked on the book's pages), on a grid of five-foot squares. What a spell does is its 'effects', a list of operations run in order (realmwalker/rules/engine/effects.py lists them all: attack, darts, save, condition, heal, modifier, zone, aura, guardian, summon, teleport, push, ignite, burn, slow, no_opportunity, no_heal, mark, lose_turn, stabilize, restore, revive, identify). How it is aimed: target (enemy, ally, downed_ally, dead_ally: one creature in range and in sight; self; all_allies: friends within range; point: a square in range and in sight, the centre of a sphere, cylinder or cube or where something appears; direction: a cone, line or cube starting at the caster; item), range (feet, touch or self), area {shape: sphere, cylinder, cube, cone or line; size: feet - radius, side or length}, affects (all, enemies, allies: who an area catches; all by default), targets_up (one more target for each slot level above). cast: action (the default), bonus or reaction. concentration, and rounds: how long it lasts (10 rounds a minute, 600 an hour). fx: how the battle board shows it. components: what casting needs (V, S, M).

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.text: A mote of fire flung at one foe up to 120 feet away.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.text: A beam of numbing cold; the target loses 10 feet of speed until the start of your next turn.

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.text: Lightning from your hand; until their next turn they cannot strike at you as you step away.

chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
chill_touch.text: A touch of the grave's cold; nothing heals the wound until the end of your next turn.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.text: Three darts of force that never miss, up to 120 feet; one more for each higher slot.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.text: A 15-foot fan of flame from your hands. Dry grass catches.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.text: A thunderclap in a 15-foot cube beside you; whoever fails the save is hurled 10 feet away.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.text: Foes in a 5-foot sphere grow heavy: whoever fails can do nothing until the end of its next turn, then fails again and sleeps (concentration). A blow or a shake wakes them; elves and the dead never sleep.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: A reaction: when a blow would land, +5 AC until the start of your next turn. Cast by itself when it would turn the blow.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armour
mage_armor.text: Your AC becomes 13 + Dex while unarmoured, for eight hours.

identify.name: Identify
identify.text: Ten minutes with a strange thing, and you know what it is, what it does and whether it is cursed. Not in a fight.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.text: Three rays of fire, each aimed separately; one more for each higher slot.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.text: Freezes a person where they stand (concentration; they try to shake it off at the end of each of their turns). Blows from beside them are criticals. One more person for each higher slot.

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.text: A bonus action: vanish and reappear in a free square you can see up to 30 feet away.

web.name: Web
web.text: Sticky webs fill a 20-foot cube: hard going, and whoever is caught is held fast until they tear free (concentration).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.text: A bead of fire that bursts in a 20-foot sphere. Everyone in it burns, friend or foe.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.text: A stroke of lightning 100 feet long and 5 wide, through everyone in its way.

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.text: Hail like stones over a 20-foot circle, bruising and freezing; the ground stays treacherous for a round.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.text: Skin hard as stone: resistance to blades, points and blows, for an hour (concentration).

hold_monster.name: Hold Monster
hold_monster.text: Freezes any creature (concentration; it tries to shake it off at the end of each of its turns).

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.text: Radiant fire falls on one foe up to 60 feet away; cover does not help them.

spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare_the_dying.text: A dying ally within 15 feet stops bleeding out (30 feet from level 5).

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.text: Add 1d4 to ability checks for a minute (concentration).

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.text: Heals by touch (2d8 and your modifier), and eases one wound.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.text: A bonus action: a word of power that heals someone up to 60 feet away.

bless.name: Bless
bless.text: Up to three allies within 30 feet add 1d4 to attacks and saves (concentration); one more for each higher slot.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.text: A flash of light; the next attack roll against the target, before the end of your next turn, has advantage.

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.text: A touch that rots flesh; a Constitution save for half.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.text: A bonus action: +2 AC to one ally (concentration).

command.name: Command
command.text: One word, 'Grovel!': on its next turn it throws itself down and does nothing else. One more for each higher slot.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.text: A bonus action: a floating weapon of force appears and strikes; each turn after, a bonus action moves it 20 feet and strikes again (concentration).

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.text: A bonus action: ends a paralysis, a blindness, a poison or a deafness, and eases a disease taking hold.

spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit_guardians.text: Spirits wheel around you for 15 feet: enemies who come into them or end their turn there burn, and move at half speed (concentration).

mass_healing_word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass_healing_word.text: A bonus action: up to six allies within 60 feet heal a little.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.text: Brings back someone dead less than a minute, with 1 hit point. The spell consumes a diamond worth 300 gold.

guardian_of_faith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardian_of_faith.text: A faceless guardian in armour appears up to 30 feet away and strikes at every enemy who comes within 10 feet of it, until it has dealt 60 damage.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.text: For eight hours: the first blow that would fell them leaves them standing at one hit point instead.

mass_cure_wounds.name: Mass Cure Wounds
mass_cure_wounds.text: Up to six allies in a 30-foot sphere within 60 feet heal 5d8 and your modifier, and a wound eases on each.

flame_strike.name: Flame Strike
flame_strike.text: A column of divine fire, 10 feet across, wherever you choose within 60 feet: fire and holy light.

spells._thrown: Flasks thrown from the Item menu (items.json use.throw): aimed like a spell, Dexterity save against the thrower's 8 + proficiency + Dexterity, no spell slot.

thrown_oil.name: Burning Oil
thrown_oil.text: A lit flask of oil bursts into flame on one square within 20 feet (Dexterity save for half), and the oil burns on there for a round.

thrown_holy_water.name: Holy Water
thrown_holy_water.text: Blessed water splashed over one square within 20 feet: it burns the walking dead (Dexterity save for half), and does nothing to the living.

thrown_fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
thrown_fire.text: Liquid fire bursts over one square within 20 feet (Dexterity save for half), and keeps burning there for two rounds.
